scope: Predeclared limited proper-torsion fitting handoff. Chemistry acceptance remains separate. Native values listed below are current analogy parameters, not quantum-fitted parameters.

selected_terms.name: sulfur_ligand_attachment
selected_terms.initial_fit_scope: Only the explicit heavy-atom proper tuple above. Preserve hydrogen-ended and every other torsion. Up to n=1,2,3 Fourier amplitudes per selected tuple; total six amplitudes maximum. Phases follow a recorded fixed convention.
selected_terms.type_pattern_scope_check: The current pattern has exactly one occurrence; re-enumerate after whole-protein integration and reject any unintended change outside the selected source tuple.

selected_terms.name: reacted_ligand_linker
selected_terms.initial_fit_scope: Only the explicit heavy-atom proper tuple above. Preserve hydrogen-ended and every other torsion. Up to n=1,2,3 Fourier amplitudes per selected tuple; total six amplitudes maximum. Phases follow a recorded fixed convention.
selected_terms.type_pattern_scope_check: The current pattern has exactly one occurrence; re-enumerate after whole-protein integration and reject any unintended change outside the selected source tuple.

frozen_parameters: Joint exact-parent constrained RESP charges, including all 18 canonical cap/backbone charges
All bond and angle parameters pending a separate Hessian/gradient evidence review
All improper torsions, canonical ff14SB peptide mechanics, 1-4 electrostatic and LJ scaling
All proper torsions except the two explicit source quadruples

reference_contract.method: Qualified dispersion-corrected full-parent provider with exact functional/B3LYP variant, D3 version and two-body policy, expanded DZVP basis, state, units, worker/runtime and all artifact hashes recorded. No RHF-only conformational accuracy claim.
reference_contract.graph: Same complete 94-atom reacted product, charge 0, spin 0, stable atom IDs, two stereocenters, no truncation or second reaction
reference_contract.geometry: Accepted parent and explicitly constrained torsion geometries with same five cap heavy atoms. Any cheaper geometry protocol requires the separate method-feasibility gate and remains labeled. Record all companion angles; reject bond-breaking, stereo changes, unconverged constraints or collisions.
point_payload: source graph and accepted parent result hashes
coordinates in explicit units, array hash, native job status and actual convergence
target and realized periodic torsion angle; fixed-cap displacement
QM electronic, dispersion and total energy; total and separated gradients when available
unchanged native-MM component energies/forces at those exact coordinates with current joint RESP charge artifact hash

dataset_split.status: Targets declared before fitting, not jobs launched
dataset_split.angle_convention: Periodic offsets in degrees from accepted parent torsion; wrap to [-180,180). Independent profiles of each selected axis. The same parent baseline is shared.
dataset_split.failed_points: Remain in the planned denominator. Never replace failed geometries with easier points or relabel held-out data as training to improve reported validation.
dataset_split.earlier_six_point_diagnostics: Remain separate diagnostics; do not present already-consulted points as unseen validation.
dataset_split.resource_gate: Root controller must qualify full-parent cost and geometry protocol before launching this larger dataset. No schedule or completion claim here.

fitting_contract.model: Fit only up to six selected proper-torsion Fourier amplitudes, all other terms and charges fixed. Regularization and amplitude limits require a recorded pre-fit rationale. Check design-matrix rank and conditioning before fitting.
fitting_contract.objective: Use consistent QM versus unchanged-MM relative energies. A common nuisance offset for the QM/MM energy origin may be fitted or removed explicitly; this is never a cross-engine conversion correction. Record weights and omitted/high-energy points before the fit.
fitting_contract.tool: Native Amber Paramfit has only synthetic upstream numerical qualification so far. A selected-term run must verify that the chosen parameter inventory exactly matches this plan.
fitting_contract.export: Enumerate every changed atom tuple/term. Retain multiplicities, phase convention and 1-4 rules; check full capped/polymer native and OpenMM/GROMACS energy-force transport without fitted engine offsets.

acceptance_obligations: Held-out relative energies and gradients/torques, before/after comparison, periodic continuity and shape of minima/barriers
No improvement claim from training error alone, no softening toward steric clashes or new incorrect minima
A second independent conformational context and full protein-complex geometry must be assessed; a one-dimensional gas-phase scan is not a free-energy surface
Actual covalent bond/angle geometry and unrestrained dynamics require separate checks after parameter fidelity passes
Fixed 15-complex benchmark remains the full application denominator
